typeDescriptions.receiver: Receivers collect telemetry data from various sources and formats.
typeDescriptions.processor: Processors transform, filter, or enrich telemetry data between receivers and exporters.
typeDescriptions.exporter: Exporters send telemetry data to one or more backends or destinations.
typeDescriptions.extension: Extensions provide additional capabilities to the collector without processing telemetry data.
typeDescriptions.connector: Connectors act as both an exporter and a receiver, joining two pipelines together.

stabilityDescriptions.development: Not all pieces of the component are in place yet. The component should not be used in production.
stabilityDescriptions.alpha: The component is ready to be used for limited non-critical workloads and the authors of this component would welcome your feedback.
stabilityDescriptions.beta: Same as Alpha, but the configuration options are deemed stable. Suitable for broader usage.
stabilityDescriptions.stable: The component is ready for general availability. Breaking changes are not expected to happen without prior notice.
stabilityDescriptions.deprecated: The component is planned to be removed in a future version and no further support will be provided.
stabilityDescriptions.unmaintained: The component is no longer actively maintained. New issues will likely not be worked on.

manifest.description: Paste a builder-config.yaml. Its receivers, processors, exporters, connectors, and extensions are added to your build, and its dist.name becomes your distribution name.

config.description: Paste a Collector configuration file. Every component it configures is added to your build.

distributions.title: Start from a pre-built distribution
distributions.description: Add the components of an official OpenTelemetry Collector distribution. Membership comes from each component's metadata, so it can differ slightly from the distribution's release manifest.
distributions.otelcol: The core distribution: OTLP plus a set of widely used components.
distributions.otelcol-contrib: Nearly every component from the core and contrib repositories.
distributions.otelcol-k8s: Components for running the Collector on Kubernetes.
distributions.otelcol-otlp: A minimal distribution that only receives and exports OTLP.

local.go: Install <goLink>Go</goLink>. OCB uses it to compile your Collector.
local.install: Install OCB v{{version}}. Its version has to match the Collector version of your components.
local.installAlt: Or download a prebuilt ocb binary from the OCB v{{version}} release and run it in place of builder.
local.build: Build your Collector. OCB writes the binary to {{binary}}.
local.run: Run it with your Collector configuration.

docker.dockerfile: Next to it, create a Dockerfile. The first stage builds your Collector with the OCB image, and the second packages the binary in a minimal image.
docker.run: Run it, mounting your Collector configuration.

github.save: Commit the manifest to your repository as {{file}}.
github.workflow: Add this workflow as {{path}}. It builds your Collector whenever the manifest changes, and whenever you run it by hand.
github.artifact: Download the binary from the workflow run's {{name}} artifact.
